applicability: Validating support-polygon margin math for later stance placement
Providing a passive-tipping oracle for center-of-pressure instrumentation
claim: For the exact L1.3 prism on seven independent real-Jolt COM-offset worlds at 60 Hz, a center-of-mass offset of +0.28 m stays stable while +0.32 m tips around the analytically predicted 0.30 m support-polygon edge, and the mirrored -0.36 m case tips in the opposite direction. Raw-point impulse-weighted center of pressure and a pre-pivot slip gate confirm the pivot is a support-edge rotation rather than a slide.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the L1.0-L1.7 contact-engine observations named by the exact source-pinned programs. L1.8 and the knowledge guard are supplementary constraints. It establishes no articulated load-bearing limb, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, walking, accepted knowledge, automatic creature guidance, or per-foot allocation of reconstructed whole-system load.

programs.claim_scope: The static prism distinguishes COM inside and outside the analytic support edge.

failure_boundaries: Does not cover dynamic tipping under motion, impact, or applied moments
Does not cover the unmeasured interior of the 0.28-0.32 m bracket
Does not cover articulated bodies, active balance, or any recovery response
Does not establish standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, or walking
mechanism: A static rigid body tips when the gravity line of action through its center of mass leaves the support polygon. The measured stable/tip bracket 0.28-0.32 m around the authored 0.30 m half-width matches that static criterion, and the sign of the offset selects the tipping direction. This is passive support-edge truth with no controller or actuation.

parameter_effects.affects: static stable-versus-tip classification and tipping direction
parameter_effects.change: increase magnitude across the preregistered offset grid
hinges_on: The authored support half-width remaining 0.30 m
No pre-pivot slip contaminating the rotation
parameter_effects.mechanism: The gravity line of action crosses the authored support-polygon edge near 0.30 m and the offset sign selects the pivot side

scope: One unjointed rigid prism under gravity on a flat static floor, independent fresh world per authored internal COM offset, authored support half-width 0.30 m as the analytic tipping oracle, 60 Hz Jolt physics, Godot 4.7, full_contacts_v2 observer with adversarial config and geometry refusal in the runner.
